articles.title: Flugverkehr: Streiks bei Lufthansa beeinträchtigen Frankfurter Flughafen
articles.teaser: Wegen mehrerer Streiktage bei der Lufthansa sind im April deutlich weniger Reisende via den Frankfurter Flughafen geflogen. Fraport zählte rund 4,8 Millionen Passagiere.
articles.image_title: Flugverkehr: Lufthansa Pilots Launch 48-Hour Strike FRANKFURT AM MAIN, GERMANY - APRIL 13: Parked Lufthansa aircraft are lined up in front of a maintenance hangar at Frankfurt Airport on the first of a two-day strike by Lufthansa pilots on April 13, 2026 in Frankfurt, Germany. The strike is grounding hundreds of Lufthansa and Eurowings passenger flights. The Vereinigung Cockpit (VC) labour union has launched the strike due to what it says are inadequate offers by Lufthansa over pilots' pay and retirement benefits. (Photo by Thomas Lohnes/Getty Images)
